old_text: Evolutionary biologists are interested in knowing how old the universe is. According to one estimate, the universe is almost 20 billion years old. The elements hydrogen and helium are supposed to appear immediately after the Big Bang. The earth is supposed to have been formed about 4.5 billion years back.

old_text: Darwin's finches, a group of fourteen closely related species of birds collected by Darwin from Galapagos Islands, provide a good example of adaptive radiation, where a group of closely related species arises from a common ancestor and evolves different structures suited to the different needs, in this case different beaks for different eating habits.
